[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.9.2 - repairs[/b][/size]

Repair only, to Fernand and Juan in the Port District.

Fernand was handing out a plain potion that his brother's rescue no longer accepted -- a
misfire in 0.8.1's fix, which had repointed the Mute Sailor's reward instead of Fernand's. He
gives his own draught now.

Juan could be drained with the spirit skills from across the dock, which hung the quest. He now
spawns as a dying man rather than a corpse, thanks you before he moves, and warns you at twenty
seconds if you are slow.

And the brothers' reunion the game wrote and never played -- [i]"Mi hermano! You saved me!"[/i] /
[i]"Claro que si!"[/i] -- plays, followed by Fernand chiding him for fishing off the north island
alone.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. Needs a character who hasn't entered the Port District
yet; the dialogue and the bottle's name work on any save.
